Name: Shallum, Son of Shaul
Summary: Son of Shaul son of Simeon and father of Mibsam.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:25: Son of Shaul son of Simeon and father of Mibsam.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shallum stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
